facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: improvement notice - critical control at HT-9002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9002 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HT-9002 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9002 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 1 January 2017 a regulatory notice was issued concerning HT-9002 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop following a statutory inspection.
